selection_policy.candidate_preference: Choose the least-glowed active concepts first; within a count tier preserve author and mechanic coverage and use a distant foil.
selection_policy.pair_objective: Maximize mechanic, interaction, consequence, uncertainty, control-modality, silhouette, palette, spatial, and temporal distance while retaining artifact completeness and deterministic replay evidence.
selection_policy.history_policy: The 1,000-row concept ledgers remain immutable provenance. Growth concepts live in the separate pool-growth seed registry.

novelty_requirements: new causal idea rather than a reskin or parameter variant
explicit closest-prior comparison against every active concept and mechanic registry
at least one exclusive core mechanic or structurally new mechanic composition
weighted mechanic overlap no greater than 0.65 with its nearest active game
distinct control, topology, information, consequence, or temporal structure
runnable deterministic v1 seed with honest win and loss evidence
no copied names, art, characters, layouts, code, or level sequences

structural_audit.method: AST traversal with identifiers and constants erased, four-node shingles, pairwise Jaccard
